name: Adaptogen Lab — DPP Studio
tagline: Same product. Same composition. Rendered compliantly for three markets.
description: Digital Product Passport system showing how a product's composition travels across EU, US, and China regulatory frameworks. Each claim is grounded against the target market's ruleset — not generated by the model. Includes the supply_chain_oracle for real BOM pricing via web search.

schema_json.description: Action grammar for the regulatory_lens_translator agent.

canonical_document.description: The product composition — the DPP source of truth. Handler falls back to platform apps directory if not present in workspace.

action_types.description: Render the product composition through a single regulatory lens.
Compare all three markets side by side. Accepts override_source_claims to test modified claim text against the real rulesets.

override_source_claims.description: Optional: [{id, candidate_text}] to test modified claims without writing to the workspace first.

action_types.description: Explain a specific divergence point between two markets.

workspace_template.note: Rulesets and composition are read from the platform apps directory by the handler. No seeding required — workspaces can optionally override with custom YAMLs.
